gain.label: Level
gain.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0 to 4.

force_lo.label: Bow force, light
force_lo.hover: The bow's force against its speed at a light touch: low is airy, high bites. Range 0.3 to 1.6.

force_hi.label: Bow force, full
force_hi.hover: The bow's force against its speed at a full press: above about 1.1 it turns raucous. Range 0.3 to 1.6.

force_over.label: Bow grit
force_over.hover: The grit added when pressing beyond a full press: 0 none. Range 0 to 2.

speed_curve.label: Bow speed curve
speed_curve.hover: How the bow speed follows pressure: 0 even, 1 the loud end opens up faster. Range 0 to 1.

rosin.label: Rosin
rosin.hover: The bow's grainy noise texture. Range 0 to 0.2.

pos.label: Bow position
pos.hover: Where the bow sits on the string, as a fraction of its length from the bridge: small is bright and glassy, large is soft and dark. Range 0.05 to 0.2.

pos_tilt.label: Position by timbre
pos_tilt.hover: How far timbre moves the bow: up towards the bridge, down towards the fingerboard. Range 0 to 1.5 octaves.

pos_press.label: Position by pressure
pos_press.hover: How far a light bow drifts towards the fingerboard. Range 0 to 1 octaves.

damp.label: String ring
damp.hover: How long the string rings on its own, measured on a low note. Range 0.5 to 10 s.

bright.label: Brightness
bright.hover: How sharp the string's corners are: above 1 brighter, below 1 rounder. Range 0.3 to 3.

tone_lo.label: Treble, light
tone_lo.hover: The treble at a light touch. Range 0 to 3.

tone_hi.label: Treble, full
tone_hi.hover: The treble at a full press. Range 0 to 3.

body_size.label: Body size
body_size.hover: The size of the body: 1 a violin, 0.8 a viola, 0.45 a cello, 0.3 a bass. Range 0.2 to 1.5.

body_track.label: Body follows register
body_track.hover: Whether the body shrinks for low notes: 0 a fixed body, 1 it follows the note. Range 0 to 1.

body_amt.label: Body
body_amt.hover: How much of the resonant body you hear. Range 0 to 2.

body_q.label: Body sharpness
body_q.hover: How sharp the body's resonances are. Range 0.3 to 3.

hill.label: Bridge hill
hill.hover: The brilliance of the bridge hill, a violin body's 2 to 3 kHz glow. Range 0 to 3.

direct.label: Direct string
direct.hover: How much of the string you hear without the body. Range 0 to 2.

acc_force.label: Accent
acc_force.hover: How much firmer the bow bites at a strike: the start's scratch and bite. Range 0 to 3.

acc_time.label: Accent length
acc_time.hover: How long the accent lasts before the note settles. Range 0.002 to 0.2 s.

acc_noise.label: Accent noise
acc_noise.hover: The extra bow noise at a strike. Range 0 to 1.

acc_bright.label: Accent brightness
acc_bright.hover: How much brighter the start of a struck note is than the sustain. Range 0 to 2.

rel.label: Release
rel.hover: How long the string rings after a slow release, when the bow stops on the string. Range 0.02 to 3 s.

rel_ped.label: Release with pedal
rel_ped.hover: How much longer the release gets with the sustain pedal down. Range 0 to 10 s.

rel_lift.label: Release on a lift
rel_lift.hover: How much longer the string rings after a quick lift-off, as a multiplier on the release. Range 0 to 20.

vibrato.label: Vibrato
vibrato.hover: The depth of the automatic vibrato that sets in after the note starts. Range 0 to 60.

vib_hz.label: Vibrato rate
vib_hz.hover: How fast the vibrato wavers. Range 2 to 9 Hz.

vib_delay.label: Vibrato delay
vib_delay.hover: How long after the start the vibrato reaches its full depth. Range 0 to 2 s.

life.label: Life
life.hover: Micro-randomness: 0 every note identical, 1 each one slightly different. Range 0 to 1.

tremolo.label: Tremolo by shake
tremolo.hover: How much a shake (the motion input) moves the bow; a strong shake reverses it into a tremolo. Range 0 to 2.

body_rot.label: Body by rotation
body_rot.hover: How far rotation (the motion input) shifts the body resonances, in octaves. Range -2 to 2 octaves.

ensemble.label: Section
ensemble.hover: The level of two more players on the note: 0 solo. Range 0 to 1.5.

ens_detune.label: Section detune
ens_detune.hover: How far the extra players wander from the pitch. Range 0 to 25 cents.

ens_spread.label: Section spread
ens_spread.hover: How far apart in time the extra players play. Range 2 to 25 ms.

pizz.label: Pizzicato
pizz.hover: Plucked instead of bowed: on or off. Range off or on.

pizz_decay.label: Pluck ring
pizz_decay.hover: How long a plucked note rings while held, measured on middle C. Range 0.1 to 5 s.

pizz_bright.label: Pluck sharpness
pizz_bright.hover: How sharp the pluck is: higher is brighter. Range 0.2 to 5.
